annotations.title: Search parenting guides for preschool children

description: Search Minik Günlük's free parenting guides (in Turkish) for children aged 0-6: nursery/kindergarten adjustment, sleep, eating, toilet training, tantrums, screen time, going to school when sick, medicine safety at home, play, sibling jealousy, talking with the teacher. Returns title, summary, category, age range, reading time, article URL and up to 3 practical tips. Call with no arguments to list the latest guides. Always show the article URL to the user. Guides are general information, not medical advice. TR: Okul öncesi çocuk ebeveyn rehberi makalelerinde arar; ör. query "kreşe uyum", "uyku düzeni", "tuvalet eğitimi", "öfke nöbeti", "ekran süresi", "ateşli çocuk okula gider mi", "kardeş kıskançlığı".

category.description: Optional category filter as published on the site (e.g. "Uyku", "Beslenme", "Okula uyum"). / İsteğe bağlı kategori.

query.description: Keywords in Turkish or English, e.g. "uyku", "tantrum", "tuvalet eğitimi". Optional. / Anahtar kelime (isteğe bağlı).
